author: kid-azn
body: Most Vietnamese foods around the Westminster/Fountain Valley area are mom and pops. I’ve been going to Mi A Dong for a super comforting egg noodle soup since I was in elementary with my parents. Vientiane Lao Thai restaurant is a very unassuming place in Garden Grove, but man their food always hits.

author: kid-azn
body: Mi a Dong in Fountain Valley is ran by an older couple that have been so kind to my family for 20+ years now. Their egg noodle soup is extremely comforting
